🎮 Welcome to Build an Anime Character! ⚡

⚔️ Face off against other players in exciting 1v1 battles!
🎲 Spin for characters from your favorite anime!
💪 Combine the best stats from different anime characters to build the strongest anime character!
🏆 Win battles, earn cash, and climb the ranks!


📋 NEW UPDATE! 🔥
- New Mythical Rarity!
- 50 New Characters including the Ten Tails, Whitebeard, Founding Titan and more!
- New Game Modes to try!
- UI Revamp!


🎁 USE CODES FOR FREE REWARDS:
- FREESPIN
- 100CASH

💬 Found a bug or have a suggestion? Submit feedback in-game!
⭐ Join the group for more updates, and don't forget to like & favorite the game!
